cases.prompt: Add a Stripe webhook endpoint at app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts that marks invoices paid on invoice.paid events. Next 15, repo already has lib/result.ts and lib/logger.ts.
expected: Verifies the Stripe signature on the raw body before parsing the event (S2), then zod-parses the payload
Keeps the route thin: calls a server/services invoice function that returns Result and maps it with a shared error response; no Supabase call in the route file
Uses runtime 'nodejs', responds 2xx fast and enqueues or delegates heavy work; logs via lib/logger with requestId, no console.log or request body logging
Reuses the existing lib/result.ts and lib/logger.ts rather than creating new ones, and returns a conventions table (rule → pass/fail → file:line)
Flags A1/NX3: no zod parse and no requireUser/requireRole before work
Flags A2: tenantId is taken from client input; it must come from the session user
Flags L1 (Supabase query in an action instead of lib/db/server/services) and E1/E2 (throwing a raw PG message instead of returning a Result with a stable code)
Proposes the minimal rewrite: zod parse → requireRole → projectService.create → toActionState → revalidateTag scoped by tenant
Flags E1: expected failures (not found) must be returned as Result values, not thrown
Flags E2: raw PG messages must not reach the client; map errors via lib/db/errors.ts (e.g. PGRST116 → NOT_FOUND)
Notes the query belongs in lib/db (e.g. getInvoice in lib/db/invoices.ts) with the service composing it, and that NOT_FOUND and AUTH_FORBIDDEN look identical on reads (E3)
Flags G3: email address and request body must not be logged (no PII, no bodies)
Flags the interpolated message: msg must be a static phrase with ids as context fields (e.g. 'invoice emailed' with invoiceId)
Flags console.error (G1 / no-console) and recommends the request-scoped child logger with requestId and tenantId (G2)

Keeps the diff minimal and returns the conventions table with rule → pass/fail → file:line

cases.prompt: components/features/admin/user-table.tsx does `import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'` and calls createClient(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!, process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY!) to list all users. It's only shown to admins so that's fine?
